description: This file is a shell script used for self-healing network connectivity, performing tasks such as ping tests, DNS checks, and router resets based on system configurations and responses.

methods.name: getCorrectiveActionState
methods.description: Retrieves the current corrective action state from system configuration.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoStartPing
methods.description: Calculates a random delay before starting the ping test to avoid simultaneous testing.

methods.name: resetRouter
methods.description: Reboots the router by simulating a device reboot.

methods.name: resetNeeded
methods.description: Decides whether to reset the router based on process name, typically for PING.

methods.name: runDNSPingTest
methods.description: Performs DNS ping test by resolving a URL and possibly triggering corrective action.

methods.name: runPingTest
methods.description: Performs a network ping test to verify connectivity, and triggers reset if failure occurs.
